profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Affirm
profile.summary:
I'm an iOS Engineer with 12 years of experience in building large-scale and impactful mobile apps. Versed in leading mobile teams to deliver high-quality apps to drive business and meet end-user needs. Always open to using the latest technology stack and improving my skillset.

♦ Expertise in building Enterprise level iOS applications using Swift from Swift 2.0, SwiftUI, Objective-C, and Xcode workspace projects.

♦ Well-versed in leading the onsite and offshore teams, and mentoring engineers in the team. Also, worked very closely with cross-functional teams, product managers, UI/UX designers, and data analytics engineers, marketing teams.

♦ Have a strong foundation in Object-Oriented concepts, Protocol Oriented Programming, and different design patterns including MVVM, VIPER, MVP, MVC, etc.

♦ Great knowledge of working with RESTFUL web services using URLSession with JSON, Protobuf
, and GraphQL. Also with 3rd party frameworks like AlamoFire, AFNetworking, etc.

♦ Well versed working with dependency managers like Swift Package Manager,
Cocoa-pods to create scalable modular applications.

♦ Expertise in Agile software development methodologies such as the SCRUM model, and tools such
as Jira, Pivotal Tracker, GIT, and SourceTree, etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS
positions.description:
The RealReal is an authenticated luxury consignment marketplace where you can buy and sell luxury goods from top designers across women’s and men’s fashion, fine jewelry and watches, fine art and home. This is an e-commerce application that drives their business on iPad & iPhone devices.

My key responsibilities are: 

 - Developing various features like browsing & searching products in the application
 - Integrate with PayPal and Apple Pay
 - Propose design solution for various features in the application
 - Integrate Analytics SDK’s like google Analytics, Tune Analytics etc
 -  Code review of Git pull requests.
 - Work closely and collaborate with other engineering and business teams during development

positions.title: Senior Developer - iOS
positions.description:
This is an iPad application that is meant for mutual fund investors with Fidelity Worldwide Investments to manage their accounts. Also the application shows the latest market value of each fund and also provides several expert reviews and comments about the funds. The application also provides a content rich dashboard space where all market data is represented using various graphs and chart components. It also includes various data analytics integrations that help the customer engagement team to gather all the customer statistics and utilize this data to improve experience of the app.

My key responsibilities were:

 - Coordinating with UI/UX designers and Business analysts in UK to gather requirements of the  application.
 - Technical design and development of UI and model layer of the several modules in the application.
 - Implement the data analytics of the entire application
 - Lead junior developers and perform Code Review regularly.
 - Memory management and Leaks control of the entire application
 - Ensure timely delivery of builds on a daily basis with respect to Sprint Plan.
